title: From Military Service to Truck Driving: Veteran Drivers Talk About Their New Military Trucks
summary: Meet Knight Transportation’s newest Fleet of Heroes! Army veteran truck drivers share their service stories and react to their custom military-wrapped trucks.
body_markdown:
Welcome to a special Veterans Day episode of the *Beyond the Rig* podcast. In this Veterans Day trucking blog, Knight Transportation honors the brave men and women who served our country.


We celebrated their sacrifice through our[Knight Transportation Fleet of Heroes program](https://www.knighttrans.com/military/) . These custom military-wrapped semi-trucks honor military history and the freedom they fought for every day. A proud veteran driver sits behind every wheel.


Today, we feature Army veterans in trucking: Anthony Evans and Marcia Luchenbill. They are our newest Fleet of Heroes drivers. Together, they share their service stories, road moments, and why veterans excel on the highway.


## Meet Our Fleet of Heroes Drivers


Veteran **Anthony Evans** , a[Knight Transportation Phoenix Refrigerated](https://www.knighttrans.com/locations/phoenix-az/) driver, served in the Army for 22 years. He worked as a tank commander, drill sergeant, and operations sergeant. Basically, as he says, he played with the giant tanks and blew stuff up. Eventually, he retired from cold Colorado and moved to sunny Arizona. He has driven with Knight for 12 years.


**Marcia Luchenbill** joined the Army right before 9/11. She served in Germany and deployed to Iraq. Marcia served in the Army for four years. Later, she spent 14 years as a stay-at-home mom. Then, she used her[GI Bill CDL training](https://www.knighttrans.com/cdl-school/) benefits to launch a new career. Today, she boasts seven years with Knight and was named one of the prestigious 2026 TCA Drivers of the Year!


## First Reactions to Their Custom Military Trucks


Knight President Joe Vitiritto joined the celebration to personally honor both drivers. He watched their emotional reactions as the custom rigs rolled around the corner. For Joe, picking the right people matters most.


“We are lucky to have you guys driving these trucks. I appreciate this immensely. Now you get to carry this message across the country.”


Receiving the surprise call and seeing their rigs for the first time left both drivers speechless. These custom military-wrapped semi-trucks will turn heads at every stop.


Anthony felt immense pride when he saw his rig. His truck features the American patriotic colors, the Declaration of Independence, the signatures of the Founding Fathers, and a tribute to America’s 250th anniversary.


Meanwhile, Marcia beamed as she saw her rolling tribute to women in military history. Her design honors trailblazing figures like the[Six Triple Eight postal battalion](https://www.thenmusa.org/articles/a-different-kind-of-victory-the-6888th-central-postal-directory-battalion/) and Harriet Tubman.


“I really do feel this sense of responsibility. Knight is trusting me with this, and I am not taking it lightly.”


Since Marcia previously drove the[‘Welcome Home’](https://youtu.be/LCYKpx5SkCU?si=3d0rj2CN0qFWY2pp) military-wrapped truck back in 2020, she happily coached Anthony on what comes next.


Fortunately, Anthony loves connecting with folks everywhere he stops.


“I never found a person that I didn’t like. We may disagree, but I never met one I didn’t like.”


> “The truck just kind of brought everything – my military career and my career here – full circle.” – Anthony Evans, Fleet of Heroes Driver


## Why They Joined the Military


Anthony shared a deeply moving family legacy. His grandfather died during World War II. For 68 years, his grandfather remained missing in action.


“They found him in the mountains in Burma. The military never stopped looking for missing service members.”


After decades, the military recovered his remains. Anthony’s family finally laid him to rest with full military honors.


Marcia took a different path. Living in New York City, she wanted a bigger purpose. She also craved adventure and hoped to score a beach station in Hawaii. Instead, recruiters pitched Europe.


“She told me you can get a guaranteed station of choice. So, I signed up for Germany. That sold me completely.”


## Rapid Deployments and Heavy Memories


Military life moves fast. Anthony remembers his rapid deployment for[Desert Storm](https://youtu.be/7_vYBCYlp3g?si=eBFDba7e1U1mN2tv) . His unit received orders on Thursday afternoon. Within days, they loaded massive tanks onto ships. Two weeks later, they arrived in Saudi Arabia.


Meanwhile, both drivers remember September 11 vividly. Marcia was shooting an M16 in basic training that morning. Anthony watched the news unfold from his post in Korea. Luckily, his uncle missed a meeting at the Pentagon that day. Those intense moments shaped their lifelong resilience.


## Valuable Lessons Learned While Serving


Trucking demands sharp focus. Fortunately, military service builds unmatched grit. Both drivers agree that Army life prepared them for the highway.


“We have literally been in life-and-death situations where you have to keep a level head. Didn’t get shot at today? That is a win.”


Furthermore, soldiers learn the art of “hurry up and wait.”


When shippers delay a load, veterans do not panic. Instead, they stay calm and finish the mission.


> "Anything could happen, and you just have to be adaptable. In the army, we say adapt and overcome."
>
>
> Marcia Luchenbill, Fleet of Heroes Driver


## Why Veterans Make Great Truck Drivers


Making a military-to-trucking transition feels natural for former service members.


Moving freight mirrors moving tactical equipment. Here is why veterans make great truck drivers:


- **Mission Focus:** Every delivery represents a vital mission.
- **Adaptable Mindset:** Sudden weather changes never rattle a veteran.
- **Built-In Patience:** Long stretches away from home feel completely normal.


Veterans bring sharp tactical thinking to daily freight challenges.


For Anthony, those skills were put to the test during a difficult rescue mission in Arizona. By coordinating a load swap with another driver, they were able to support one another and ensure both customers received their freight on time.


It was a good example of military strategy, teamwork, and quick problem-solving.


Do they miss military life? Not really, because trucking offers the same brotherhood.


Drivers build instant friendships at terminals across the country.


**“There is no bond like the military. But in this job, you still get that same great camaraderie.”**


Plus, the open road brings exciting mystery. On Monday, you rarely know which state you will visit by Thursday. Every mile offers a brand-new adventure.


Looking for rewarding[veteran truck driver jobs?](https://www.knighttrans.com/jobs/) Knight proudly supports service members every mile of the way.


## A Veterans Day Message to Fellow Service Members


Before wrapping up, the hosts asked for one final message to fellow veterans. Anthony delivered an inspiring call to action that left the entire room speechless. Even Marcia agreed nobody could top it.


Their message is:


> “Continue to serve your communities in whatever capacity you can. Always appreciate what past veterans did, and respect what future veterans will do.”


## Supporting Veterans Every Mile of the Way


Knight Transportation proudly goes beyond just wrapping trucks. We actively support military veterans entering the trucking industry. Qualified drivers can earn tax-free GI Bill benefits while training on the job through our[apprenticeship program.](https://youtu.be/AH_gFoYJQPU?si=xeWNddtpuxicdBhd) Furthermore, our[Military Scholarship Program](https://www.knighttrans.com/military/) covers CDL school tuition and housing costs for veterans, active reservists, National Guard members, and military spouses.


Whether you want to drive a custom Fleet of Heroes rig or launch a brand-new career, Knight provides the mission-focused support you deserve.


## Catch the Full Episode


Want to hear more inspiring stories from the road? Tune in to this special[Beyond the Rig episode](https://youtu.be/Yi7mGXCMcu0) and hear our Fleet of Heroes drivers talk about their brand-new military trucks.
